title: Claims Guide — Fixed Indexed Annuities Death Benefit Amount, Proof and Interest
content:
**Claims department guide — Ashgrove Fixed Indexed Annuities**

### The death benefit

On the owner's death the death benefit is the contract value on the date due proof is received, with no surrender charge, and including any unvested premium bonus on tiers where the death benefit includes it. The benefit base is never paid as a death benefit. On a contract in guaranteed payout status no death benefit is payable.

### Proof and approval

Death benefit is paid only on a death claim whose certified death certificate has been received and whose request status is approved. The condition is read from Ashgrove's service request record for that death claim — the certified death certificate marked received and the request status approved — and it governs paying a beneficiary's share, settling the claim, and a surviving spouse's continuation of the contract.

### Contract status at disbursement

Disbursement proceeds only while the contract status is death claim pending or claim paid. Registering notice of the owner's death places the contract in death claim pending; the claim is paid once the death benefit is paid or applied for every beneficiary.

| Contract status on the record | Disbursement proceeds? |
|---|---|
| death claim pending | Yes |
| claim paid | Yes |
| active, income phase, guaranteed payout or any other status | No |

### Death-claim interest

Interest is added at the tier's death-claim interest rate, simple, from the date due proof is received to payment, counting actual days over 365, rounded to the cent.

*Worked example (hypothetical claim; rate 3.5%, the figure printed for every tier).* A beneficiary's share of 100000; due proof received 3 March 2027; payment 18 April 2027. Actual days: 28 days from 3 March to 31 March, plus 18 days to 18 April, is 46 days. Interest: 100000 multiplied by 3.5%, multiplied by 46 and divided by 365, is 441.0958…, rounded to the cent 441.10.

### Points of judgement (hypothetical contracts)

| Facts | Reading |
|---|---|
| Ashgrove IndexEdge 10 Bonus in contract year 3 with unvested bonus in the contract value | The death benefit is the contract value including the unvested bonus, with no surrender charge |
| Ashgrove IncomeShield 7 whose benefit base is higher than its contract value | The death benefit is the contract value; the benefit base is not paid |
| Contract in guaranteed payout status | No death benefit is payable |
| Death certificate received, but the claim's request status not yet approved | Not paid |
